scopeQualifications: Exact binary-posterior consistency and other channel-specific constraints may exclude the witness and remain outside the no-go theorem.
The result does not preclude a different single-letterization, a direct multiletter code inequality, or another channel-specific converse method.
The witness is an actual finite distribution but not an actual binary-input BSSC distribution; its X is a tuple of six nondegenerate independent binary components.
This is an obstruction to the specified coarse entropy/universal-inequality/finite-copy refinement route, not a broadcast-channel capacity bound.
result-coarse-entropy-copy-no-go.statement: At uniform input, with h=h_2(1/4), c=h-1/2, and r=h-3/4, the specified coarse relaxation—comprising the seven common-noise BSSC base entropies, message/time independence, deterministic encoding, the fixed-map and memoryless Markov equalities, exact dependence balance, all stated conditional BEC identities, and the two sharp scalar BSSC posterior-support inequalities—has an actual finite entropic witness for which both direct sum branches equal 2h_2(1/4)-5/4=0.3725562489182657.... Because the witness is an actual finite distribution, adding any collection of universally valid finite-variable information inequalities cannot lower this relaxation below that value. Any finite sequence of standard copy-lemma extensions also preserves feasibility through conditional resampling while retaining the original marginal and objective. The witness has tuple-valued X formed from six nondegenerate independent binary components and is not an actual binary-input BSSC distribution.

computations: Exact symbolic verification of component positivity, the complete base entropy vector, 65 disjoint-subtuple conditional BEC identities, dependence balance, support rows, and both objective branches.
methods: Exact affine-in-h component-entropy audit and a calculus proof of the sharp scalar BSSC posterior-support inequalities.
proofs: Conditional-resampling argument showing that every finite sequence of standard copy-lemma extensions can be realized without changing the witness marginal or objective.

Explicit independent-component construction verifying the base entropy vector, structural equalities, dependence balance, all conditional BEC identities, both sharp support rows, and both objective branches.
tools: Python 3 standard-library checker verify_exact_witness.py performs the exact symbolic audit without floating-point arithmetic.

scopeQualifications: The literal formula F_j=h_2(p_j)+p_j log_2(N_j-1) applies when N_j is at least 2; singleton message alphabets require a separate harmless convention.
The message alphabets and the alphabet of W may grow with blocklength, so no fixed-cardinality support reduction or single-letter outer region is established.
The result is a structural necessary condition for deterministic private-message codes; it does not itself establish a numerical BSSC capacity bound.
result-finite-block-dependence-balance.statement: For independent uniform private messages A and B encoded deterministically over n uses of a finite-alphabet memoryless broadcast channel, let receiver errors be p_1,p_2 and set F_j=h_2(p_j)+p_j log_2(N_j-1), delta_j=F_j/n. With S_i=(Y^{i-1},Z_{i+1}^n), the exact telescope is sum_i[I(A;B|S_i,Y_i)-I(A;B|S_i,Z_i)]=I(A;B|Y^n)-I(A;B|Z^n), and Fano bounds its endpoints by F_1 and F_2. For independent uniform time T and U=A, V=B, W=S_T, X=X_T, Y=Y_T, Z=Z_T, every such code therefore satisfies |I(U;V|W,T,Y)-I(U;V|W,T,Z)|<=max{delta_1,delta_2}. Its induced law has the fixed-map factorization p(t,u,v,w,x,y,z)=(1/n)p_U(u)p_V(v)p(w|u,v,t)1{x=f_t(u,v)}P_{YZ|X}(y,z|x), and the same variables satisfy the two individual-rate rows and two compatible sum-rate rows stated in the accepted submission, with Fano defects delta_1 and delta_2. This is an exact sequence-level necessary condition, not by itself a fixed-cardinality single-letter outer region.

methods: Time sharing with an explicit time variable and preservation of the encoder coordinate map independently of the realized past/future state.
proofs: Exact endpoint-replacement telescope, separate Fano bounds, induced-law factorization, and chain-rule/Csiszar-identity derivations of all four compatible rate rows.
